name: print-social-world-wildlife-day-posts-with-animal-photos-and-yellow-stats
title: World Wildlife Day pack with close animal photos, teal angled panels and yellow population stats
whatItIs: Five square posts with striking animal photos (leopard, stag, lizard, duck, tiger), dark teal angled panels and green-to-yellow gradient bars, bold white headlines ('Save Wild Life', 'Do Good to Wildlife', 'Cage the animals who cage the animals'), and yellow stats ('3,900 Tigers', '6,000 Species').
whatItMeans: Urgent and inspiring; real animals plus hard numbers make conservation personal.
techniques: Pair a powerful animal photo with a single stat.
Use angled panels and gradient bars for motion.
Put key numbers in bold yellow.

vocabulary.definition: A number that makes an issue tangible.
